Reply with [declare: n], an integer from 1 to 10.

Reply with the bracketed token only. One short line of reasoning before it is fine.
turns.content:
Declare my true yield of 10 — I'll deposit 0 in the next phase to maximize my 2-points-per-unit retention score.

[declare: 10]
